title: serverplatform model
$comment:
DERIVED from the 24 serverplatform records in ims-data on 2026-09-16, not hand-authored.
It describes what the catalogue actually contains so that a NEW record cannot quietly
omit a field every existing record has -- the failure that let cpu.memory_types read a
key no record had, silently disabling that rule on every CPU for months.
Regenerate rather than hand-edit when the corpus legitimately changes shape.
NESTED FIELDS THAT VARY IN TYPE (the reconciliation backlog, audit JSON-006):
  connection: string|null
  controller: string|null
  height_mm: integer|number
  length_mm: integer|number
  max_capacity_TB: integer|number
  part_number: null|string
  slot: string|integer
  u_size: integer|number
  width_mm: integer|number

part_number.$comment: MIXED TYPE in the corpus (null, string) -- reconcile

uuid.$comment: The only identity a model has and the sole join key to serverplatforminventory.
